rationale: With only 27 minutes to close, IRTC is trading at 15.1% of its intraday range after a massive -15.24% gap down on mixed earnings (revenue miss despite EPS beat), showing choppy, low-momentum 1-minute candles oscillating in a tight ~$0.70 band near $90.
